column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for the CRM (spec 1005).
# Format: id<TAB>action<TAB>(name). Action: FAIL blocks the check, WARN shows
# in the report without blocking, IGNORE is not reported. Rules not listed
# FAIL: data leaks, unprotected cookies, vulnerable libraries, errors with
# internal details. None shows up today: if one does, it is a regression.
# WARN "known": what ZAP found on 2026-10-17 (security headers the CRM
# does not send yet). Fixed in its own spec; as each one is fixed, it moves
# to FAIL so it does not come back.
